settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["color", "mode"], ["red", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "red"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == "mode"
      mode = copy values[i]
    else if keys[i] == "level"
      level = copy values[i]
  var out = [mode, level]
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] != "mode" and keys[i] != "level"
      out = out + [copy values[i]]
  out

test_settings() =
  assert settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  assert settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  assert settings(["color", "mode"], ["red", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "red"]
